nodes.label: Tenant Isolation (multi-tenant data partitioning)
nodes.rationale: All database queries and service calls must enforce tenantId to prevent data leakage across tenants. This is a hard architectural constraint driven by multi-tenant hospital deployment requirements.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL + withTransaction queue (concurrency hardening)
nodes.rationale: WAL mode with synchronous=NORMAL and a sequential transaction queue (db.js) prevents SQLite corruption under concurrent requests — critical for a clinical system that must not corrupt patient data.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture: Controllers → Services → Repositories
nodes.rationale: Separation of concerns for maintainability and testability of a healthcare backend; each layer has a defined responsibility.

nodes.label: FEFO (First-Expiry First-Out) dispensing
nodes.rationale: Pharmacy stock is dispensed by earliest expiry date to minimise medication waste and reduce patient risk from expired drugs.

nodes.label: NEWS2 (National Early Warning Score 2)
nodes.rationale: Standard UK clinical risk stratification scoring system applied on patient vitals to trigger escalation workflows.

nodes.label: AuditLogs (SQLite table)
nodes.rationale: Records authenticated HTTP API requests for compliance. Tenant-scoped and admin-only for export and purge.

nodes.label: ClinicalChangeLog (SQLite table)
nodes.rationale: Records which fields were touched on patient profile updates. Intentionally stores field names only, not values, to avoid inadvertent PHI exposure in the audit trail.

nodes.label: HospitalArchives (immutable discharge snapshots)
nodes.rationale: Immutable snapshots of patient data taken at discharge to provide a point-in-time record for clinical and legal review.

nodes.label: Polymorphic DB Adapter (SQLite/Postgres)
nodes.rationale: db-adapter.js abstracts over SQLite and PostgreSQL so the application can run locally on SQLite and scale to Postgres in production without changing service/repository code.

nodes.label: PIN lockout mechanism (5 attempts, 30s lockout)
nodes.rationale: Prevents brute-force attacks on the PIN-based login. After 5 failed attempts the user is locked out for 30 seconds.

nodes.label: Offline-first with pending sync queue
nodes.rationale: The standalone ward-management.html stores data in localStorage and queues unsynced records to push to the API when connectivity is restored, enabling use in environments with unreliable internet.

nodes.label: JWT Secret Hardening (P1.1)
nodes.rationale: Prevent insecure fallback JWT secret from being used in non-dev environments by centralizing config validation. The hard-coded fallback was only usable in explicit dev mode; any non-dev mode without JWT_SECRET causes startup refusal.

nodes.label: Legacy Auth Route Quarantine (P1.2)
nodes.rationale: Moved legacy auth route to ward-backend/legacy/ with a fail-loud stub to prevent accidental mounting. The old route returned bare JSON tokens without cookie/CSRF, creating a security gap if ever mounted.

nodes.label: Explicit CSP/Security Headers (P2.1)
nodes.rationale: Configured Helmet with strict CSP for prod/staging while leaving CSP disabled in dev/test to avoid friction. The API serves JSON so CSP is defensive for any future HTML endpoints.

nodes.label: CSRF Enforcement Tightening (Step 4.2)
nodes.rationale: Tagged auth source (cookie vs header) to enforce CSRF only for cookie-auth mutations. Header-auth clients (stress harness) skip CSRF. Cookie-auth mutations missing csrf claim now fail 403.

nodes.label: PHI-Safe Logging Guardrails (Step 4.3)
nodes.rationale: Request and audit logs now store path without query string to prevent leaking sensitive query params. SECURITY_LOGGING.md added to enforce the no-req.body/secrets policy.

nodes.label: Patient Detail UI Refresh Detailed Plan
nodes.norm_label: patient detail ui refresh detailed plan

nodes.label: metricsCollector.js (in-memory metrics)
nodes.rationale: In-memory only metrics collector chosen to avoid external dependencies (no Redis needed). Metrics reset on restart; rolling window capped at 60 entries (1 hour) to avoid memory growth. Node.js single-threaded model makes mutex unnecessary.

nodes.label: Feature Flags / Kill Switches (Phase C1)
nodes.rationale: Feature flags stored in DB (persists across restarts, unlike env vars). Default values hardcoded in middleware as fallback when DB read fails (fail-open: features stay enabled if DB is down, better than disabling clinical features). Admin can toggle via API with immediate effect without restart.

nodes.label: Razorpay Per-Seat Subscription Billing
nodes.rationale: Per-seat pricing with one consolidated bill per org per billing cycle via Razorpay subscription quantity. Individual staff never see billing; only org admin is billing contact. Seat count changes at next cycle to avoid surprise mid-cycle charges. Payment features are opt-in; if Razorpay env vars absent, signup works without payment (dev-friendly).

nodes.label: Cookie Sessions & CSRF (Phase C)
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly cookie + double-submit CSRF selected over BFF proxy. Eliminates localStorage JWT storage. authenticateToken reads both Authorization header and cookie during migration window. CORS must use explicit origins (not *) when credentials: true.

nodes.label: DB Adapter Pattern (SQLite/Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Adapter interface with SQLite for tests and Postgres for prod chosen over full rewrite. DATABASE_URL presence selects adapter at runtime. SQLite kept as default for existing tests to avoid cross-cutting port risk.

nodes.label: Polling-Based Cross-Device Sync
nodes.rationale: 15-second polling interval chosen as the synchronization window; no websockets, relies on periodic refetch via TanStack Query.

nodes.label: Stress Test Pass Criteria
nodes.rationale: server5xx=0, timeouts=0, fetchErrors=0; p95 < 200ms locally / 500ms on CI. JWT (no cookie auth) used in stress to bypass CSRF by design.

nodes.label: JWT Secret Hardening
nodes.rationale: Centralized env/config validation module (ward-backend/config.js) added so JWT secret is never read directly and weak fallback cannot occur outside explicit dev mode.

nodes.label: Legacy Auth Route Quarantine
nodes.rationale: Legacy bearer-token auth route removed from routes/ and replaced with fail-loud stub in legacy/ to prevent accidental mounting.

nodes.label: Dev Credential Gating
nodes.rationale: Login form defaults gated behind import.meta.env.DEV so production builds ship with empty credentials.

nodes.label: Helmet CSP Configuration
nodes.rationale: Strict CSP enabled for prod/staging via Helmet; CSP disabled in dev/test to reduce local friction.

nodes.label: CSRF Enforcement (Cookie Auth Mutations)
nodes.rationale: CSRF now enforced only for cookie-authenticated mutation requests; header-auth clients (stress harness) bypass CSRF. authSource tagged in auth middleware.

nodes.label: PHI-Safe Logging Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Logs store path without query string to reduce PHI/secret leakage via query params; req.body logging banned by guidance doc.

nodes.label: SQLite Migration Robustness
nodes.rationale: runIgnoreDuplicateColumn() helper swallows only duplicate column errors; removed duplicate Medications.status ALTER; unexpected migration errors no longer silently ignored.

nodes.label: In-Memory Metrics Collector
nodes.rationale: In-memory only (no Redis/external store), metrics reset on restart. Rolling window capped at 60 entries. Acceptable for first launch; persistent metrics require Prometheus/TimescaleDB.

nodes.label: Alert Engine
nodes.rationale: Fires alert rules on setInterval(60s), logs to stdout and Alerts DB table, tracks active alerts to avoid duplicate firing. ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL enables future Slack/PagerDuty integration without code changes.

nodes.label: Feature Flags / Kill Switches
nodes.rationale: Flags stored in FeatureFlags DB table (persists across restarts); in-memory cache with 10s TTL; fail-open on DB read failure to prevent disabling clinical features when DB has issues.

nodes.label: Rollback Plan (Git + Feature Flag + DB)
nodes.rationale: Four rollback layers: git revert, feature flag toggle, DB restore from backup, full nuclear rollback. Pre-deploy backup script always runs before deploy.

nodes.label: Clinical Workflow Milestone Tracking
nodes.rationale: Replaces SaaS 'onboarding milestone conversion' with clinical workflow funnel: patient.admitted → vitals.recorded → medication.prescribed → escalation.created → patient.discharged.

nodes.label: Razorpay Per-Seat Subscription Billing
nodes.rationale: One Razorpay Subscription per tenant with quantity = seat count; Razorpay bills plan_amount x quantity as single consolidated org invoice. Quantity updates take effect at next billing cycle (no mid-cycle surprise charges). pricePerSeat cached in Tenants table.

nodes.label: Subscription Enforcement Middleware
nodes.rationale: Allows read-only access for past_due tenants; blocks writes with 402. Uses 503 for feature flags (temporary disable) vs 402 for payment issues. Skipped when RAZORPAY_KEY_ID not set (payment opt-in).

nodes.label: Organization Signup Flow
nodes.rationale: Two flows: org admin creates tenant+user then Razorpay subscription; staff self-registers via cryptographically random 128-bit invite code. Transaction rollback if any step fails.

nodes.label: Invitation Code System
nodes.rationale: 32-character hex codes (128 bits entropy), 7-day expiry, rate-limited validation endpoint to prevent brute-force.

nodes.label: Neutral Palette & Indigo Primary Token
nodes.rationale: Dark canvas shifted to neutral zinc (#09090b, #18181b, #27272a) with indigo primary (#4f46e5) for action buttons, replacing previous lavender/blue-grey.

nodes.label: Allergies Display Normalization
nodes.rationale: null/empty/negatives (none, n/a, nil) show as muted text; any other non-empty string shows as red/risk presentation. Documentation UX only, not clinical decision support.

nodes.label: GDPR Data Subject Export & Deletion
nodes.rationale: Proposed endpoints deferred until product scope confirms GDPR applicability (EU-facing vs internal tool). Deletion must preserve audit trail summary while removing clinical data.

nodes.label: DB Adapter (SQLite/Postgres Abstraction)
nodes.rationale: dbAdapter switches between SQLite (default for tests) and Postgres (when DATABASE_URL set). Repositories ported one by one to use adapter methods.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Cookie + CSRF Double-Submit Auth
nodes.rationale: ward_token HttpOnly cookie replaces localStorage JWT. JWT csrf claim + X-CSRF-Token header for mutations. Login omits token from JSON body.

nodes.label: Admin Monitoring Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Admin-only frontend view with Recharts line/bar charts for request rate, latency, error rate, auth health, workflow funnel, active alerts, and kill switches.

nodes.label: Global Express Error Handler
nodes.rationale: Needed because server.js currently has no (err,req,res,next) handler. Express 5 natively handles async route errors. Never leak stack to client; respond with requestId only.

nodes.label: Existing Compliance Capabilities
nodes.rationale: Tenant isolation, RBAC (doctor/nurse/admin), AuditLogs HTTP-level trail, ClinicalChangeLog, bcrypt password hashing, HttpOnly cookie with CSRF, rate limiting, account lockout.
